summary: No new source-level defects found. Prior fixes and rebuttals are supported by inspection. Required checks and execution-dependent criteria remain unverified because running checks was prohibited.

checks.criterion: 1. Tests precede implementation and an actual failing run is recorded.
checks.evidence: The historical tree at 63bc9ea contains the test before the lookup implementation; scripts/ralph/batches/t3-terrain/prd.json:167 contains the failing-run note. The historical execution was not independently observed, and rerunning it is prohibited.

checks.criterion: 2. Three lookup forms have independent forward/inverse tests and explicit required georeferencing parameters.
checks.evidence: geometry.py:510,612,760 define the three forms with required keyword fields. test_geometry_resample.py:398,409 checks defaults and omitted parameters. Independent formulas at :158,163,218,240,256,265 are exercised by directional tests at :582,597,720,742,844,864.

checks.criterion: 3. Bilinear interpolation uses only four neighbours; missing neighbours and outside points produce nodata.
checks.evidence: Static inspection supports the implementation: geometry.py:1167-1182 selects four neighbours, combines their validity and writes NaN outside validity. Tests at test_geometry_resample.py:1105,1156,1175,1186 exercise these requirements. Execution is prohibited in the read-only sandbox.

checks.criterion: 4. The window-frame plane residual meets the unchanged PRD tolerances with a stated curvature allowance.
checks.evidence: test_geometry_resample.py:2101-2117 constructs a window-frame plane, bounds curvature below half of ATOL and checks the fitted plane using RTOL=1e-10 and ATOL=1e-12 (:78-79). The numerical residual cannot be verified without the prohibited test execution.

checks.criterion: 5. Nodata footprints, all-nodata output and NaN/sentinel equivalence are tested.
checks.evidence: Nontrivial assertions cover footprints (:1199), NaN/sentinel equivalence (:1226,1390,1447), all-nodata sources (:1239,1371) and window integration (:1930). These tests were read but cannot be executed under the supplied restriction.

checks.criterion: 6. Output includes float64 values and an explicit boolean validity mask; missing values are never zero.
checks.evidence: geometry.py:1066-1088 requires matching float64/boolean arrays, finite valid values and NaN invalid values. bilinear_resample constructs these arrays at :1179-1182. test_geometry_resample.py:1687-1715 asserts the representation and rejects inconsistent masks.
Explicitly prohibited: the sandbox is read-only and dependency/test-cache writes are unavailable.
Explicitly prohibited in the read-only sandbox. Makefile defines real ruff lint, formatting and mypy checks.

checks.criterion: Prior finding codex2-r1-1: masked source observations
checks.evidence: Fix verified by reading geometry.py:1138-1157: the input mask is captured before extracting data and contributes to source validity. Regression assertions cover fully masked zeros (:1276), mixed missing representations (:1300) and resample_window (:1985).

checks.criterion: Prior finding codex2-r1-2: sentinel matching in source storage type
checks.evidence: geometry.py:1151 computes sentinel matches before float64 promotion. :1230-1264 compares floating and integer sentinels in the source dtype. Tests at test_geometry_resample.py:1466-1498 explicitly distinguish rounded float sentinels and adjacent integers beyond 2**53.

checks.criterion: Prior finding codex-r2-1 and latest underflow fix
checks.evidence: geometry.py:1241-1254 rounds under controlled overflow/underflow handling, then rejects infinite conversions and nonzero declarations rounded to zero. Tests at test_geometry_resample.py:1518-1619 cover finite rounding beyond the maximum and underflow boundaries; :1653-1684 covers overflow rejection.

checks.criterion: Prior rebuttal claude-r2-1: maximum-float cast warning
checks.evidence: The criticized pre-cast range guard is absent. geometry.py:1241-1247 controls cast overflow and validates the rounded result. Boundary cases are asserted at test_geometry_resample.py:1545 and :1682, with warnings configured as errors at :72. Runtime results remain unverified.

checks.criterion: Prior rebuttal claude-r1-1: bookkeeping outside story paths
checks.evidence: First-parent non-merge history shows product changes confined to geometry.py and test_geometry_resample.py. Other changes are story/progress bookkeeping and review/run records. scripts/ralph/prompt.md:21 permits story/progress changes; PRD.md:1534-1549 requires review and agent-run records.

checks.criterion: Prior rebuttal claude-r1-2: lookup composition tolerance
checks.evidence: Independent projection and geotransform comparisons retain RTOL=1e-10 and ATOL=1e-12 through test_geometry_resample.py:99-101. Composition tests at :975 and :992 verify wiring separately. The required small-extent plane test at :2101 retains the same tolerances.
